checks.name: Nine screens render without broken images or horizontal overflow
Level road ascends from below and opens at the current unlocked stop
A pair scores once, stays visible and retains the turn
Mismatch closes both cards, switches player and deducts no points
The first card does not reset the 15-second deadline; timeout closes it
All eight pairs end the duel with the correct reward
Draw and loss sample states use consistent scores and rewards
Sequence preview hides and a wrong answer ends the current round
Wrong path step consumes one heart and restarts the same level
Zero hearts block play and a heart refills after 30 minutes
Android offers only Google; iOS additionally offers Apple
Room code validation and guest login route are explicit demo flows
Disconnected and expired room states render as blocking sheets
